description:
Music video directed by Natsu no Owari and Haruyoshi Nagae for the song Natsu no Owari by Natsu no Owari featuring vocals by Yukari Yuzuki.

Note: The song featured in this music video was initially released as a part of the album End of Summer 6 on Aug 7, 2023, the song finished production in March 2023 and was then adjusted continously over the production cycle, due to this the song is somewhat different from the original and considered more of its own version releasing as a tie-in single for this release.
